name: Kougeki Shoujo Falselion ~Tsundere no Theory~
original_name: 光撃少女ファルセリオン ～ツンデレのセオリー～
source:
An officer of Galaxy Force, Len is back to the earth to get back "Hajimari no Sho". However, "Hajimari no Sho" is already into the criminal's hands. Galaxy Force has to take it back before they use it to change the world. Exciting transformation scenes and battle scenes arouse the story! Also, don't miss a large variety of errotic scenes.
